column1: # Where the third-party source in the Linux payload comes from, and what pins it.
# One row per upstream artifact a build fetches, plus one per Unity patch applied to the OpenUSD
# tree before it is built (artifact "patch": url is the patch's path in this repository, git_commit
# the commit it applies to). Everything else in the payload is compiled from the OpenUSD tree at
# the pinned commit, including the four libraries OpenUSD vendors in (pxr/base/tf/pxrCLI11,
# pxrDoubleConversion, pxrLZ4, pxrTslRobinMap), so those need no row of their own -- except where
# a patch replaces one, as openusd-26.05-lz4-1.10.0.patch does pxrLZ4 (SECURITY-282834). Verified by Native~/verify_upstream_sources.py; see its docstring for what a pin
# Tab-separated: component, version, artifact, url, sha256, git_commit, upstream_evidence, recorded
# A sha256 of "-" means the row pins a revision rather than a file.
